name: PSE list of projects asking to connect to the transmission grid (article 7 section 8l)
what: Use batches/poland/harvest/queues.json from scopes/poland/harvest_pse.py. Answer every row with a gas type code (BG, BGP, SG, JS) or a gas word in the name: matched to a GEM plant and checked, staged as an add, or a qa record. Rows include Turów, Pątnów, Opole Dobrzeń, Kraków Wanda, Lublin Abramowice, Łaziska and the Połaniec peaker.

name: PSE capacity market main auction results, delivery years 2021 to 2030
what: Use the auction rows in batches/poland/harvest/queues.json. Every new or upgraded unit on a 15 or 17 year contract is answered: matched to a GEM unit, identified as not gas, or researched as a possible add. Obligation MW are never staged as capacity.

name: PSE capacity market additional (quarterly) auction results
what: Skim the newest year for unit names not seen in the main auctions.

name: URE registers, including generation licenses
what: Retry through fetch.py with a slow pace and a full browser load. If it opens, check each GEM plant's operator holds a generation license and list gas licensees with no GEM plant. If every route fails on a second day, record what was tried.

name: URE public information site, license decisions
what: Search the decisions for license grants or changes naming a GEM plant or a gas unit GEM lacks.

name: Integrated permit lists on the 16 marshal offices' public information sites
what: Use scopes/poland/work/permits/ from scopes/poland/harvest_permits.py. For each region holding a GEM plant or a candidate, read every permit or permit change for a gas or oil combustion plant from 2020 on and record capacity, units and dates.
gap: Integrated permits cover combustion plants at or above the industrial emissions threshold (50 MW thermal); a smaller plant holds a sector emission permit from the county or city office, read under city-bip-decisions, and the environmental decision under govpl-rdos-gdos.

name: Regional and national environment office decisions and notices on gov.pl
what: Use the gov.pl search results the permit harvester saves for every GEM plant and candidate name, and read each matched decision or notice.

name: City and town public information sites (environmental decisions by the city head)
what: For every plant in development, find its environmental decision: look up the case on the ekoportal list by municipality, then read the decision on the city site. Record which plants have none online.

name: European Environment Agency large combustion plant and industrial installation tables, version 16
what: List every Polish large combustion plant burning natural gas in 2023 or 2024 and answer each: matched to a GEM plant, under 20 MW electric, or a possible add.

name: ENTSO-E installed capacity per production unit, Poland
what: With the API token, pull gas and oil units for Poland and match each to a GEM unit; a unit GEM lacks is a possible add, a capacity disagreement is a task.

name: PSE open data, generation per unit
what: For every unit GEM shows under construction with a start year of 2026 or earlier, check whether the unit code reports output, and cite it as evidence of operation only alongside a named source.

name: Owner press rooms: PGE, PGE Energia Ciepła, Orlen, Energa, Enea, Tauron, Veolia, Fortum, CEZ, Polenergia, KGHM, Synthos, Grupa Azoty
what: Read each owner's releases from 2024 on for gas plant decisions, contracts, start-ups and closures, and each annual report's list of units.

name: Polish energy trade press: wnp.pl, cire.pl, enerad.pl, gramwzielone.pl, wysokienapiecie.pl, energetyka24.com
what: Search each for gas plant news from 2025 on, by plant and owner name, and for new gas engine sets at heat plants.

name: Data center campuses with backup generation
what: Use scopes/poland/work/permits/_data_centers.md from data_center_fleets.py. Answer every campus whose summed backup generators may reach 20 MW, starting with Atman Warsaw-3, Equinix WA3 and WA4, Data4 Jawczyce, Vantage WAW1 and Beyond.pl Poznań.

name: Coal plants in the unfiltered export
what: For each live coal plant (Bełchatów, Opole, Łaziska, Turów, Pątnów, Konin, Połaniec, Jaworzno, Kozienice and the city heat plants), check for a gas unit added or planned at the site or a conversion to gas.
